Schaeffler is a dynamic global technology company and its success has been a result of its
entrepreneurial spirit and long history of private ownership. Does that sound interesting to you? As a partner to all of the major automobile manufacturers, as well as key players in the aerospace and industrial sectors, we offer you many development opportunities.
 General Information
 We have an opportunity for a Project Purchasing Professional to join us at Schaeffler Motion Technologies Romania, in Brasov or Timisoara on a Hybrid work schedule.
In this role, you will contribute to strategically important projects and have a direct impact within a dynamic international environment. You will play a key role in developing competitive sourcing solutions for automotive projects and leading purchasing activities across the full product development cycle, from acquisition through start of production. You'll work in close collaboration with project teams, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to ensure delivery performance, cost efficiency, and supply reliability.
 Your Key Responsibilities
Lead purchasing-related project activities to achieve the lowest total cost for the assigned components and reduce working capital through effective negotiation planning and execution.
Define and execute project-related sourcing activities, including Make-or-Buy analyses.
Ensure early supplier involvement in the development process and monitor supplier, material, sourcing, and APQP/PPAP status in coordination with Supplier Quality Management.
Develop and implement cost-reduction programs and support cost-based redesign initiatives.
Contribute to project quotations, workshops, bill-of-material evaluations, savings opportunities and technical changes.
Support purchasing strategies, supplier and market analysis, supplier evaluation and second-sourcing activities to secure continuous supply under competitive terms.
Lead supplier workshops focused on value analysis and critical project components or functions.
 Your Qualifications
University graduate – Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, such as Engineering or Business Administration.
Minimum 3 years of experience in purchasing functions or project management roles; experience in the automotive industry is an advantage.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to drive projects to completion.
Advanced commercial knowledge.
Advanced negotiation, presentation and meeting-facilitation skills.
Basic knowledge of contract law and advanced knowledge of IT tools and methods.
Business-level English proficiency.
Ability to work effectively and negotiate in intercultural teams.
 Our Offering
Onboarding & Integration: we help you settle in quickly through our onboarding program and a team that supports you.
Health & Life Insurance: we provide private health plans and life insurance, so you can have peace of mind.
Discounts: enjoy discounts from our partners on activities, trainings, goods etc.
Bookster Subscription: are you a passionate reader? Then you can borrow your favorite books from the Bookster Library.
Professional Development: with our variety of projects and teams, you'll be able to learn new skills, develop and shape the career path that fits you best.
Bonuses: performance bonuses reward your achievements, and through referral bonuses we thank you for helping our team grow.
Gift for Special Occasions: celebrate Easter, 8th of March or the Winter Holiday.
Vacation Days: we truly believe in long-term partnerships, and we’re committed to supporting your well-being with a generous vacation policy from the start of your journey with us.
Meal Tickets: we’re happy to offer meal tickets as part of your everyday benefits, helping make your lunch breaks more enjoyable.
Flexibility: you can balance your work and personal life with arrangements tailored to your job and responsibilities.
 As a global company with employees around the world, it is important to us that we treat each other with respect and value all ideas and perspectives. By appreciating our differences, we inspire creativity and drive innovation. In this way, we contribute to sustainable value creation for our stakeholders and society as a whole. Together, we advance how the world moves.
Exciting assignments and outstanding development opportunities await you because we impact the future with innovation. We look forward to your application.
